audit.why: 54.25% over 153 Emerald+ games with a front-loaded lane: Heimerdinger's nest dominates levels 2-5, Ryze takes over on items. Difficulty 6/10 matches.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart contradicted the packet chart and its own why-text: rows 4-5, 6 and First item read 'Skill' while every why describes Heimerdinger dominating, and the 2+ item row read 'Skill' while whys[6] says Ryze out-scales hard. Level 1 read 'Heimerdinger' while whys[0] says neither side can commit.
audit.corrected: Chart set to packet: Skill / Heimerdinger x5 / Ryze, proposed as matched full+content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated the decisive interaction: Overload (Q) and Spell Flux (E) both stop on the first enemy struck, so a deployed turret body-blocks them. Ryze's ultimate was described as changing an all-in when Realm Warp is a 3000-range portal with no combat effect.
audit.corrected: Stand behind a turret so Overload hits it; Rune Prison is 615 range on 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and must be walked into your 970-range E and 1325-range W to land; Realm Warp is a 180/160/140s portal, not burst.

audit.why: Rune Prison at 9-11s is correctly named as the punishable cooldown; added the real number to the TL;DR.

edits.before: Weather the poke — nest up and stun his Rune Prison dive. Heimerdinger wins the Rune Prison cooldown windows.
edits.after: Turrets body-block Overload — nest between you and Ryze, and E-stun when Rune Prison (9-11s) is down.

edits.before: Keep Ryze farming inside turret range, W-poke his step-ups, and E-stun the moment he commits into the nest.
edits.after: Stand behind a turret so Overload hits it, W-poke his step-ups, and E-stun the moment he walks in to detonate Flux.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: UPGRADE!!! gives a super-turret to out-siege him or a wider, longer stun. Realm Warp is a 180s portal, not combat power.

notes: suspectNames flagged 'Realm Warps' in whys[6] — false positive, that is the correct ability name in verb form. Left alone. Ryze's Q/E are first-enemy-hit projectiles, so turret body-blocking is the key interaction and was absent everywhere; added to tradeGood and tldr only, since the duplicated copies (breakdown.trading, report[3].t, dosFull[1].d) repeat the old trade line verbatim and were left consistent-but-unimproved rather than risk partial edits.
